title: Reverse Traffic Properties
description: Properties associated with an event where a vehicle is detected moving in the wrong direction within a monitored zone.

vehicle_view.description: The camera or sensor view from which the vehicle was observed moving in reverse traffic.

type.description: The type or category of the vehicle detected (e.g., car, truck, motorcycle, bus).

zoneid.description: The identifier of the zone or road segment where the reverse traffic violation was detected.
